d: On behalf of Zimmermann, we are hiring for a Stock Coordinator to join the first store in Bahrain!

Zimmermann is one of Australia's leading and most respected fashion designer brands. Zimmermann's ready-to-wear and swim and resort collections are sold through Zimmermann boutiques and high-end retailers both in Australia and internationally. We maintain stand-alone retail stores throughout Australia, Europe, UK, USA and China and a successful online business.
q: The successful candidate should have experience working with stock control management, amazing customer service skills, impeccable attention to detail and exceptional communication skills.
To be successful, you will be flexible, dynamic and eager to learn!
Experience in a similar role within Luxury fashion retail
Can conduct financial and style-specific stocktakes
Ability to investigate discrepancies and resolutions.
Experience in using inventory control software
Bespoke development plans and access to strong mentors and industry leaders
Ongoing Training & Development to grow your career within Zimmermann
Seasonal uniform provided to all team members
Generous Employee Discount and Bonus Structure

r: You will be responsible for overseeing the organisation of stock movements and inventory. The objective of the position is to create a memorable brand experience, reduce shrinkage by maintaining accurate stock inventory and a high functioning stockroom.
